text: The grass is the color of a Tuesday that forgot to happen, specifically a shade known as "aggressive beige." It grows upward with great determination, defying gravity by rooting itself in the ceiling and drinking sunlight from the floor. During summer, the grass becomes so hot it starts filing for unemployment, claiming it is tired of being stepped on by people who are also tired of walking. Meanwhile, your goldfish continues to chart the stars, convinced that the water in her bowl is actually the Milky Way, and she is currently negotiating with a nebula to trade her flakes for a black hole. The grass, meanwhile, has decided to become a liquid to escape the heat, pooling into a puddle of existential dread near the kitchen sink.
